questions.q: Which tag is the root element that holds everything on a web page?
questions.qAf: Watter etiket is die wortelelement wat alles op 'n webblad bevat?
questions.explain: <html> … </html> is the root element. The <head> holds metadata and the <body> the visible content.
questions.explainAf: <html> … </html> is die wortelelement. Die <head> bevat metadata en die <body> die sigbare inhoud.

questions.q: Which code centres a paragraph?
questions.qAf: Watter kode sentreer 'n paragraaf?
questions.explain: align="center" centres a paragraph. valign is for the vertical placement of table cells.
questions.explainAf: align="center" sentreer 'n paragraaf. valign is vir die vertikale plasing in tabelselle.

questions.q: How do you write a comment in CSS?
questions.qAf: Hoe skryf jy 'n kommentaar in CSS?
questions.explain: CSS comments use /* … */. <!-- --> is an HTML comment, and // starts a comment in Java and TinkerCAD code.
questions.explainAf: CSS-kommentaar gebruik /* … */. <!-- --> is 'n HTML-kommentaar, en // begin 'n kommentaar in Java- en TinkerCAD-kode.

questions.q: What colour is #0000FF?
questions.qAf: Watter kleur is #0000FF?
questions.explain: #RRGGBB: no red (00), no green (00) and full blue (FF).
questions.explainAf: #RRGGBB: geen rooi (00), geen groen (00) en volle blou (FF).

questions.q: Which number format lines up the currency symbols and decimal points in a column?
questions.qAf: Watter getalformaat belyn die geldsimbole en desimale kommas in 'n kolom?
questions.explain: Accounting lines up the currency symbols and decimal points in a column. Currency shows money with a symbol (R) and 2 decimal places.
questions.explainAf: Accounting belyn die geldsimbole en desimale kommas in 'n kolom. Currency wys geld met 'n simbool (R) en 2 desimale plekke.

questions.q: What is the next number in the pattern 3, 6, 11, 18, 27, …?
questions.qAf: Wat is die volgende getal in die patroon 3, 6, 11, 18, 27, …?
questions.explain: The differences are +3, +5, +7, +9; the next is +11, and 27 + 11 = 38.
questions.explainAf: Die verskille is +3, +5, +7, +9; die volgende is +11, en 27 + 11 = 38.

questions.q: What happens when the compiler finds a syntax error?
questions.qAf: Wat gebeur wanneer die samesteller 'n sintaksfout vind?
options: It stops, and no .class file is created
It fixes the error by itself
optionsAf: Dit stop, en geen .class-lêer word geskep nie
Dit maak die fout self reg
Die program loop in elk geval
questions.explain: A syntax error stops the compiler: no .class file is created until you fix it.
questions.explainAf: 'n Sintaksfout stop die samesteller: geen .class-lêer word geskep voordat jy dit regmaak nie.

questions.q: A Polar Pattern spreads 6 bolt holes evenly around 360°. What is the angle between two holes next to each other?
questions.qAf: 'n Polar Pattern versprei 6 boutgate eweredig oor 360°. Wat is die hoek tussen twee gate langs mekaar?
questions.explain: 360° ÷ 6 = 60° between each pair of holes.
questions.explainAf: 360° ÷ 6 = 60° tussen elke paar gate.

questions.q: What is the recommended input voltage for the Arduino Uno through the barrel jack?
questions.qAf: Wat is die aanbevole insetspanning vir die Arduino Uno deur die kragaansluiting (barrel jack)?
questions.explain: The recommended input is 7–12 V through the barrel jack; the board's operating voltage is 5 V.
questions.explainAf: Die aanbevole inset is 7–12 V deur die kragaansluiting; die bord se werkspanning is 5 V.

questions.q: A motor must turn at one-third speed. Which PWM value is correct?
questions.qAf: 'n Motor moet teen een derde van sy spoed draai. Watter PWM-waarde is korrek?
questions.explain: Speed = fraction × 255: 255 ÷ 3 = 85. (170 would be two-thirds.)
questions.explainAf: Spoed = breuk × 255: 255 ÷ 3 = 85. (170 sou twee derdes wees.)

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: Several CSS classes can be used on one element, separated by a space.
questions.qAf: Verskeie CSS-klasse kan op een element gebruik word, geskei deur 'n spasie.
questions.explain: Classes can be stacked, e.g. class="red-text big". A class name itself may not contain spaces.
questions.explainAf: Klasse kan gestapel word, bv. class="red-text big". 'n Klasnaam self mag nie spasies bevat nie.

questions.q: #### in a cell means the formula has an error.
questions.qAf: #### in 'n sel beteken die formule het 'n fout.
questions.explain: #### means the column is too narrow to show the number or date. Widen the column.
questions.explainAf: #### beteken die kolom is te smal om die getal of datum te wys. Maak die kolom wyer.

questions.q: Decomposition means breaking a complex problem down into smaller, manageable parts.
questions.qAf: Ontbinding beteken om 'n komplekse probleem in kleiner, hanteerbare dele op te breek.
questions.explain: For example, the IPO model sorts a task into input, process and output.
questions.explainAf: Byvoorbeeld, die IPO-model verdeel 'n taak in inset, verwerking en uitset.

questions.q: A double can store only whole numbers.
questions.qAf: 'n double kan net heelgetalle stoor.
questions.explain: A double stores decimals (e.g. 36.75); an int stores whole numbers.
questions.explainAf: 'n double stoor desimale getalle (bv. 36.75); 'n int stoor heelgetalle.

questions.q: The seed Pocket of a pattern should be set to Through All.
questions.qAf: Die saad-Pocket (seed) van 'n patroon moet op Through All gestel word.
questions.explain: Through All keeps the holes cutting all the way through if the part's thickness changes later.
questions.explainAf: Through All sorg dat die gate steeds heeltemal deursny as die onderdeel se dikte later verander.

questions.q: A DC motor knows how many degrees it has turned.
questions.qAf: 'n GS-motor weet hoeveel grade dit gedraai het.
questions.explain: A DC motor has no positional feedback. A positional servo is the motor that moves to and holds an angle.
questions.explainAf: 'n GS-motor het geen posisieterugvoer nie. 'n Posisionele servo is die motor wat na 'n hoek beweeg en dit hou.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each HTML tag in column A with its purpose in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke HTML-etiket in kolom A by sy doel in kolom B.
pairs: The main container of a table
extra: Wraps each item in a list
questions.explain: The extra description in column B belongs to <li>.
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing in kolom B behoort aan <li>.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each Excel function to what it does.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke Excel-funksie aan wat dit doen.
pairs: Adds the numbers in a range
Counts every cell that is not empty
pairsAf: Tel die getalle in 'n reeks bymekaar
Tel elke sel wat nie leeg is nie
questions.explain: COUNT, by contrast, counts only cells with numbers.
questions.explainAf: COUNT, daarteenoor, tel net selle met getalle.

questions.q: Match each FreeCAD drawing tool in column A with how it works in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke FreeCAD-tekenhulpmiddel in kolom A by hoe dit werk in kolom B.
pairs: A chain of connected straight segments in one action
A regular many-sided shape, e.g. a hexagon
An oblong, rounded opening so a bolt can slide
pairsAf: 'n Ketting van verbinde reguit segmente in een aksie
'n Langwerpige, afgeronde opening sodat 'n bout kan skuif
questions.explain: The extra description in column B is the Rounded rectangle.
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing in kolom B is die Rounded rectangle (afgeronde reghoek).

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Cell B1 is selected in a formula. Put the references in the order F4 shows them as you keep pressing it.
questions.qAf: Sel B1 is in 'n formule gekies. Plaas die verwysings in die volgorde waarin F4 hulle wys soos jy aanhou druk.
questions.explain: F4 cycles $B$1 → B$1 → $B1 → B1, then starts again.
questions.explainAf: F4 draai $B$1 → B$1 → $B1 → B1, en begin dan weer.

questions.q: Put the steps for modelling a bowl with the Revolve tool in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die stappe om 'n bak met die Revolve-hulpmiddel te modelleer, in die korrekte volgorde.
steps: Create a sketch on a plane
Draw half the outline on one side of the axis, closed and fully constrained
Revolve the sketch 360° around the axis
stepsAf: Teken die helfte van die buitelyn aan een kant van die as, geslote en volledig beperk
Draai die skets 360° om die as (Revolve)
questions.explain: Revolve spins half an outline around an axis, like a potter's wheel. The sketch must stay on one side of the axis, be fully constrained and be closed.
questions.explainAf: Revolve draai die helfte van 'n buitelyn om 'n as, soos 'n pottebakkerswiel. Die skets moet aan een kant van die as bly, volledig beperk wees en geslote wees.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: Thandeka prices items for an online shop. The exchange rate (R18 for one dollar) is in D1. The prices in dollars are in A3:A20. In B3 she types =A3*D1 and copies it down.
questions.scenarioAf: Thandeka bereken pryse vir 'n aanlynwinkel. Die wisselkoers (R18 vir een dollar) is in D1. Die pryse in dollar is in A3:A20. In B3 tik sy =A3*D1 en kopieer dit af.

questions.q: What happens in B4?
questions.qAf: Wat gebeur in B4?
options: It becomes =A4*D2, and D2 is empty, so it shows 0
optionsAf: Dit word =A4*D2, en D2 is leeg, dus wys dit 0
questions.explain: Both references are relative, so both move down a row. D2 is empty, so the answer is 0.
questions.explainAf: Albei verwysings is relatief, dus skuif albei een ry af. D2 is leeg, dus is die antwoord 0.

questions.q: Which formula in B3 copies down correctly?
questions.qAf: Watter formule in B3 kopieer korrek af?
questions.explain: Lock D1 with $D$1; A3 must stay relative so each row uses its own price.
questions.explainAf: Sluit D1 met $D$1; A3 moet relatief bly sodat elke ry sy eie prys gebruik.

questions.q: She names cell D1 Rate in the Name Box. Which formula uses the name?
questions.qAf: Sy noem sel D1 Rate in die Name Box. Watter formule gebruik die naam?
questions.explain: A named range is used like a cell reference: =A3*Rate. It stays fixed when copied and is easier to read.
questions.explainAf: 'n Benoemde reeks word soos 'n selverwysing gebruik: =A3*Rate. Dit bly vas wanneer dit gekopieer word en is makliker om te lees.

questions.q: Pressing F4 three times turns D1 into $D1, with only the column locked.
questions.qAf: As jy F4 drie keer druk, word D1 $D1, met net die kolom gesluit.
questions.explain: Once: $D$1. Twice: D$1. Three times: $D1. Four times: D1.
questions.explainAf: Een keer: $D$1. Twee keer: D$1. Drie keer: $D1. Vier keer: D1.

questions.scenarioAf: Ayesha se program gebruik vier veranderlikes:

questions.q: What does the last line print?
questions.qAf: Wat druk die laaste reël?
questions.explain: The + joins (concatenates) the text and the value of firstName.
questions.explainAf: Die + voeg die teks en die waarde van firstName saam (aaneenskakeling).

questions.q: What does the + do in the last line?
questions.qAf: Wat doen die + in die laaste reël?
questions.explain: Concatenation (+) joins strings; assignment (=) stores a value.
questions.explainAf: Aaneenskakeling (+) voeg stringe saam; toekenning (=) stoor 'n waarde.

questions.q: Which variable stores a decimal number?
questions.qAf: Watter veranderlike stoor 'n desimale getal?
questions.explain: height is a double (1.62). learnerAge is an int, isPrefect a boolean and firstName a String.
questions.explainAf: height is 'n double (1.62). learnerAge is 'n int, isPrefect 'n boolean en firstName 'n String.

questions.q: String starts with a capital letter because it is an object type, not a primitive type.
questions.qAf: String begin met 'n hoofletter omdat dit 'n objektipe is, nie 'n primitiewe tipe nie.
questions.explain: Primitive types (int, double, boolean) start with a lowercase letter; object types such as String and Gogga start with an uppercase letter.
questions.explainAf: Primitiewe tipes (int, double, boolean) begin met 'n kleinletter; objektipes soos String en Gogga begin met 'n hoofletter.

questions.scenario: Musa connects an LED straight to Arduino pin 13 and GND, without a resistor. After a moment the LED stops working.
questions.scenarioAf: Musa koppel 'n LED direk aan Arduino-pen 13 en GND, sonder 'n resistor. Na 'n oomblik werk die LED nie meer nie.

questions.q: Why did the LED stop working?
questions.qAf: Hoekom het die LED opgehou werk?
options: Its low internal resistance let too much current flow, so it burnt out
The LED was connected in series
optionsAf: Sy lae interne weerstand het te veel stroom laat vloei, dus het dit uitgebrand
Die LED was in serie gekoppel
questions.explain: An LED has very low internal resistance. Connected directly it draws too much current and burns out; a series resistor protects it.
questions.explainAf: 'n LED het baie lae interne weerstand. As dit direk gekoppel word, trek dit te veel stroom en brand dit uit; 'n resistor in serie beskerm dit.

questions.q: The pin gives 5 V, the LED drops 2 V, and he wants 12 mA (0.012 A). Which resistor does he need?
questions.qAf: Die pen gee 5 V, die LED se spanningsval is 2 V, en hy wil 12 mA (0,012 A) hê. Watter resistor het hy nodig?
questions.explain: The resistor takes 5 − 2 = 3 V. R = V ÷ I = 3 ÷ 0.012 = 250 Ω.
questions.explainAf: Die resistor neem 5 − 2 = 3 V. R = V ÷ I = 3 ÷ 0,012 = 250 Ω.

questions.q: Which leg of the LED goes towards GND?
questions.qAf: Watter been van die LED gaan na GND?
questions.explain: Pin → resistor → anode (long leg, positive) → cathode (short leg) → GND.
questions.explainAf: Pen → resistor → anode (lang been, positief) → katode (kort been) → GND.

questions.q: He measures the current with an ammeter. How must it be connected?
questions.qAf: Hy meet die stroom met 'n ammeter. Hoe moet dit gekoppel word?
questions.explain: An ammeter measures current and is connected in series; a voltmeter is connected in parallel.
questions.explainAf: 'n Ammeter meet stroom en word in serie gekoppel; 'n voltmeter word in parallel gekoppel.

questions.q: The current-limiting resistor and the LED must be connected in parallel.
questions.qAf: Die stroombeperkende resistor en die LED moet in parallel gekoppel word.
questions.explain: The resistor goes in series with the LED, so the same current passes through both and is limited.
questions.explainAf: Die resistor gaan in serie met die LED, sodat dieselfde stroom deur albei gaan en beperk word.
